AFM.description: Top level executable entity. Combination of [A]ttributes, [F]ilters & [M]etrics.

AbsoluteDateFilter.description: A datetime filter specifying exact from and to values.

emptyValueHandling.description: Specifies how rows with empty (null/missing) date values should be handled. INCLUDE includes empty dates in addition to the date range restriction, EXCLUDE removes rows with empty dates (default), ONLY keeps only rows with empty dates.

AbsoluteGranularityDateFilter.description: An absolute date range filter defined at a specific granularity. The 'from'/'to' literals must match the format of the chosen granularity (e.g. '2020' for YEAR, '2012-05' for MONTH, '2012-3' for QUARTER, '1996-01' for WEEK, '2010-10-30' for DAY, or a plain ordinal like '6' for periodical granularities such as MONTH_OF_YEAR). At least one of 'from'/'to' must be provided; specifying only one yields an open-ended range.

emptyValueHandling.description: Specifies how rows with empty (null/missing) date values should be handled. INCLUDE includes empty dates in addition to the date range restriction, EXCLUDE removes rows with empty dates (default), ONLY keeps only rows with empty dates.

from.description: Start of the range (including), in the format matching 'granularity'. If omitted, the range is unbounded at the start.

granularity.description: Granularity determining the filtered date attribute and the expected 'from'/'to' format.

to.description: End of the range (including), in the format matching 'granularity'. If omitted, the range is unbounded at the end.

* ```false``` - return items matching ```patternFilter``` and ```exactFilter```
* ```true``` - return items not matching ```patternFilter``` and ```exactFilter```

Excludes items from the result that differ only by primary label
